image.shortdescription: Graph of a function, its derivative, and its second derivative.

statement.p: Identify the graphs A (blue), B( red) and C (green) as the graphs of a function and its derivatives:
is the graph of the function
is the graph of the function's first derivative
is the graph of the function's second derivative

solution.p: We can interpret f'(x) as the slope of the curve y = f(x) at the point (x, f(x)). Therefore f'(x) is negative when y = f(x) has negative slope and positive when y = f(x) has positive slope.
Similarly, f''(x) is negative when y= f'(x) has negative slope and positive when y = f'(x) has positive slope.
It follows that C is the graph of the function, B is the graph of the function's first derivative and A is the graph of the function's second derivative.
